svg.title: Compiled temporal dependency DAG
svg.desc: The exact seven-node, eleven-edge graph compiled from the committed synthetic itinerary. Colored arrows show release, bounded duration, hard deadline, and transfer constraints. Full canonical SHA-256 digests are visible.
svg.text: contract v1 → graph v1 • 7 nodes • 11 constraints • synthetic fixture
Every card below is emitted from one TemporalEdge.
Constraint compilation only — no route choice, live travel data, reliability estimate, or prediction.
